sloka: अभिषिक्ते च भरते राघवे च वनं गते ।जात्येन च सुवर्णेन सुविष्टप्तेन मन्थरे ॥२-९-४८॥
transliteration: abhiṣikte ca bharate rāghave ca vanaṁ gate ।jātyena ca suvarṇena suviṣṭaptena manthare ॥2-9-48॥

translations.english: O Manthara, when my objective is accomplished and I am fully satisfied, I will smear your hump with the best of refined liquid gold.
